## Testing Mode

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying:
- DD4 (partial): Unit tests written for new sections in reviewer-base.md and reviewer-delta-test-quality.md

## Implementation Steps

Create `tests/docs/test-reviewer-not-flag-rules.sh` (per Rule 5 — structural boundary tests for LLM instruction files):

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail
REPO_ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
source "$REPO_ROOT/tests/lib/assert.sh"
REVIEWER_BASE="$REPO_ROOT/plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base.md"
REVIEWER_DELTA_TQ="$REPO_ROOT/plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-delta-test-quality.md"

echo "=== test_not_flag_rules_section_exists ==="
if grep -q '^## NOT-Flag Auto-Downgrade Rules' "$REVIEWER_BASE"; then
    assert_eq "reviewer-base.md contains ## NOT-Flag Auto-Downgrade Rules section" "present" "present"
else
    assert_eq "reviewer-base.md contains ## NOT-Flag Auto-Downgrade Rules section" \
        "heading present" "heading not found"
fi

echo "=== test_not_flag_exemption_exists ==="
if grep -q '^## NOT-Flag' "$REVIEWER_DELTA_TQ"; then
    assert_eq "reviewer-delta-test-quality.md contains NOT-Flag exemption section" "present" "present"
else
    assert_eq "reviewer-delta-test-quality.md contains NOT-Flag exemption section" \
        "exemption present" "exemption not found"
fi

print_summary
```

This test intentionally fails (RED) until T3 adds:
- `## NOT-Flag Auto-Downgrade Rules` section to reviewer-base.md
- An exemption section (any `^## NOT-Flag...` heading) to reviewer-delta-test-quality.md

Set executable bit: `chmod +x tests/docs/test-reviewer-not-flag-rules.sh`

Update `.test-index`:
1. Append to the existing `plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base.md` entry:
   `,tests/docs/test-reviewer-not-flag-rules.sh [test_not_flag_rules_section_exists]`
2. Add NEW key (reviewer-delta-test-quality.md has no existing entry):
   `plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-delta-test-quality.md:tests/docs/test-reviewer-not-flag-rules.sh [test_not_flag_exemption_exists]`
